entries.title: I Chronicles 13:1
segments: ¶Then David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, [and] with every leader.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:2
segments: And David said to all the assembly of Israel, "If [it seems] good to you, and if it is of the LORD our God, let us send out to our brethren everywhere [who are] left in all the land of Israel, and with them to the priests and Levites [who are] in their cities [and] their common-lands, that they may gather together to us;

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:3
segments: "and let us bring the ark of our God back to us, for we have not inquired at it since the days of Saul."

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:4
segments: Then all the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:5
segments: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor in Egypt to as far as the entrance of Hamath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath Jearim.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:6
segments: And David and all Israel went up to Baalah, to Kirjath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God the LORD, who dwells [between] the cherubim, where [His] name is proclaimed.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:7
segments: So they carried the ark of God on a new cart from the house of Abinadab, and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:8
segments: Then David and all Israel played [music] before God with all [their] might, with singing, on harps, on stringed instruments, on tambourines, on cymbals, and with trumpets.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:9
segments: ¶And when they came to Chidon's threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:10
segments: Then the anger of the LORD was aroused against Uzza, and He struck him because he put his hand to the ark; and he died there before God.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:11
segments: And David became angry because of the LORD'S outbreak against Uzza; therefore that place is called Perez Uzza to this day.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:12
segments: David was afraid of God that day, saying, "How can I bring the ark of God to me?"

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:13
segments: So David would not move the ark with him into the City of David, but took it aside into the house of Obed-Edom the Gittite.

entries.title: I Chronicles 13:14
segments: The ark of God remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months. And the LORD blessed the house of Obed-Edom and all that he had.
